sanskrit: ratnāni sūtrairbaddhyante | tasmāt sadārādhanapravṛtte mayyasūyā na kartavyeti || 3 ||
tatprāptaye ca kalādiṣatprakāro'dhvā śivena śāstreṣu varṇyate || 6 ||
athobhāvapi sarvajñau matibhedaḥ kathaṃ tayoḥ || iti | prasiddhistu teṣāṃ
āptastu śiva evaikaḥ śivānye tvaśivā matāḥ || 11 ||
vinivṛttaye | teṣāṃ talliṅgamautsukyaṃ muktau dveṣo bhavasthitau || bhaktiśca
guruṇā dīkṣito yadā | sarvajñaḥ sa śivo yadvat (vi0 1|21) iti || 12 ||
ca siddhāntābhyāsena, tadabhyāsaśca śaktipātāvinābhāvinyā dīkṣayā siddhyatītyuktam ||
tasyātmasvarūpasya parīkṣaṇamapi siddhāntoktaireva hetubhiḥ kāryamiti bhāvaḥ || 17 ||
trīṇi ratnāni ko vetti siddhānteta vinā svayam || 18 ||
tadvad yogaṃ ca ko vetti sabījābījalakṣaṇam || 19 ||
proktaṃ sūkṣmaṃ cintāmayaṃ bhavet | cintayā rahitaṃ yattu tatparaṃ parikīrtitam || (1|8) ||
tatra vidyābhujaḥ pūrve mantrā vidyāśca nāmataḥ || 24 ||
tatra prathame vidyātattvanivāsina ityāha- tatra vidyābhuja iti || 24 ||
siddhibhāṅmantrasāmarthyāt (39|2) iti | atha paśusadāśivānāha- pare sadāśivasamā iti || 29
ityuktaṃ śrīmatpauṣkare- sādhakasya tu lakṣyārthaṃ tasya rūpamidaṃ smṛtam iti || 30 ||
eṣo'pi sadāśivādiradhvā vikārī, tato nityopādānakāraṇa iti || 32 ||
sadavasthaṃ hi vastvekaṃ pūrvaṃ kṣīraṃ tato dadhi || 37 ||
na māyā neśvaro nāṇurna śaktiḥ śuddhavartmanaḥ || 39 ||
savikalpajñānaviṣaya eva śarīriṇāṃ kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ || 45 ||
savikalpakavijñānamayaṃ ghaṭa iti parāmarśarūpāt śabdollekhādevāt-mano dṛśyate ||
anantasya baindavaśarīrayogaḥ śrūyate, tadupādānatayā binduḥ siddhyatīti bhāvaḥ ||
kalpitena, īśvara ātmā tacchaktirvā śuddhādhvanyupādānamastu, ata āha- tathaivāyamiti || 48
siddhamāgameṣu śrūyate | ityato'sya na vikāraḥ saṃbhavati || 51 ||
